title: 第3章 贷款买石（求收藏！求追读！求月票！）
novel_title: 长生修仙，从装备土龙鳞开始
content_zh:
跨过禁制的刹那，林玄的目光迅速扫视着场中的石料。

    一百七十六号。

    三百零九号。

    五百二十一号。

    ...

    林玄脚步飞快，每块石头只是粗略地扫了一眼数字牌，就看向下一个。

    终于，半炷香后，他脚步停在了广场东南角一块西瓜大小的土黄色石料前。

    这块石料表面粗糙，布满暗褐色斑纹，看起来并不起眼，比旁边的几块石料要普通许多。

    可林玄却没管那么多，只因在这石料下方的木牌上，赫然写着几个字。

    八百四十三号。

    “找到了。”

    他再往下看，只见木牌之下，另有一行小字。

    【售价：七十块灵石。】

    林玄心头顿时一沉。

    他现在最多能筹集到五十七块灵石，离七十块灵石差了足足十三块。

    林玄站在原地，斗篷下的眉头越皱越紧。

    “等两个月后，攒够灵石了再买吗？”

    “不。”

    林玄暗自摇头。

    万一这中间被其他人买了去，他能被气得吐血。

    片刻后，林玄目光一定，转头往广场旁边的一处偏厅走去。

    ......

    林玄站在偏厅门口，只见门上挂着一块木牌，上面写着“押契借灵”。

    赌石场既然敢开在这里，自然不缺帮人“凑灵石”的手段，只是利息相当高。

    林玄刚走进偏厅，便听见里面传来一阵嘶哑的大喊。

    “我要贷灵石！”

    “我是炼气中期修士，每个月最少也有四十块灵石！”

    “我只贷一百块！就一百块！”

    “这次一定能回本！一定能回本！求你了！”

    林玄脚步一顿，抬眼望去。

    就见厅中跪着一名胡子拉碴，眼神灰败的中年修士，正“砰砰砰”地朝着柜台后的锦袍管事磕头。

    柜台后方，锦袍管事手里拨弄着一只玉算盘，闻言只是冷冷一笑。

    “一百块灵石？”

    “你还是先把这几个月欠下的灵石还了，再言其他吧。”

    那胡子修士脸色一变，急忙道。

    “再给我一次机会！就一次！”

    “我昨日看中了一块好石，绝对能开出好东西的啊！”

    锦袍管事终于抬起头，眼神淡淡。

    “把人扔出去。”

    话音刚落，厅侧便走出两名身形高大的壮汉。

    虽然只有炼气初期的修为，但中年修士却根本不敢反抗，像只死狗一样地被拖了出去。

    “再给我一次机会！”
content_en:
The moment he crossed the restriction, Lin Xuan's eyes quickly scanned the stones in the field.

    Number one hundred and seventy-six.

    Number three hundred and nine.

    Number five hundred and twenty-one.

    ...

    Lin Xuan walked quickly. Each stone just glanced at the number plate briefly before looking at the next one.

    Finally, after half a stick of incense, he stopped in front of a watermelon-sized khaki stone in the southeast corner of the square.

    The surface of this stone is rough and covered with dark brown markings. It looks inconspicuous and is much more ordinary than the stones next to it.

    But Lin Xuan didn't care so much, because there were a few words clearly written on the wooden sign under the stone.

    Number eight hundred and forty-three.

    "Found it."

    He looked down and saw another line of small words under the wooden sign.

    [Sale price: seventy spiritual stones. 】

    Lin Xuan's heart suddenly sank.

    He can now raise up to fifty-seven spiritual stones, which is a full thirteen stones short of seventy.

    Lin Xuan stood there, his brows frowning under his cloak getting tighter and tighter.

    "Should you wait two months before buying enough spiritual stones?"

    "No."

    Lin Xuan shook his head secretly.

    If someone else bought it in the meantime, he would be so angry that he vomited blood.

    After a while, Lin Xuan's eyes were fixed, and he turned around and walked towards a side hall next to the square.

    ...

    Lin Xuan stood at the door of the side hall and saw a wooden sign hanging on the door, which read "Deed to borrow spirits".

    Since the stone betting shop dares to open here, it naturally has no shortage of means to help people "collect spiritual stones", but the interest rate is quite high.

    As soon as Lin Xuan walked into the side hall, he heard a hoarse shout coming from inside.

    "I want to borrow spiritual stones!"

    "I am a mid-stage Qi refining monk, and I have at least forty spiritual stones every month!"

    "I only lend a hundred yuan! Just a hundred yuan!"

    "I will definitely get my money back this time! I will definitely get my money back! Please!"

    Lin Xuan paused and looked up.

    He saw a middle-aged monk with unshaven beard and gray eyes kneeling in the hall, kowtowing "bang bang bang" to the brocade-robed steward behind the counter.

    Behind the counter, the steward in golden robes was fiddling with a jade abacus in his hand. Hearing this, he just smiled coldly.

    "A hundred spiritual stones?"

    "You'd better pay back the spiritual stones you've owed over the past few months before talking about anything else."

    The bearded monk's expression changed and he said hurriedly.

    "Give me another chance! Just once!"

    "I took a fancy to a good stone yesterday. It will definitely yield good things!"

    The brocade-robed steward finally raised his head, his eyes indifferent.

    "Throw people out."

    As soon as he finished speaking, two tall and strong men walked out of the hall.

    Although he was only at the early stage of Qi refining, the middle-aged monk did not dare to resist at all and was dragged out like a dead dog.

    "Give me another chance!"
